subject: 新绛福胜寺弥陀殿北立面
caption: 福胜寺 · 弥陀殿北立面
元代遗构 · 明代修缮
source_note: 选用弥陀殿完整北立面实拍，保留重檐围廊、三间后墙及两侧廊间；移除树木和后院前景矮墙，续接可见对称檐线。图注明确北立面；南向高台基不移植到北侧图上。现木构按元代遗构、明代修缮断代，未把北齐建寺传说或存在纪年换算争议的塑像题记当作殿的精确竣工年。

Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: the actual AMITABHA HALL (MITUO DIAN), FUSHENG TEMPLE, GUANG VILLAGE, XINJIANG COUNTY, SHANXI 福胜寺弥陀殿, as viewed from its NORTH REAR ELEVATION in photo2. Draw only the CENTRAL HALL, omitting every building on the left and right. Preserve the complete DOUBLE-EAVED XIESHAN hipped-gable roof, the upper roof steep and almost square, lower roof spreading widely over a continuous surrounding veranda. The hall is FIVE BAYS overall including one open veranda bay at EACH SIDE; three central wall bays are set behind the posts, central plain paired wood door, plastered solid wall bay on each side, no windows invented. Keep the thin timber veranda columns, broad plain wall band between the two roof eaves, two large ridge-end ornaments and small central roof finial exactly as visible. Do not convert into a two-storey pavilion: this is a ONE-STOREY HALL with surrounding lower-eaved veranda. Photo2 north side rests on the LOW stone platform shown, with a few central steps only. Do not add a tall stair, five-metre front podium, gate, balustrade or grand forecourt. Remove both enormous foreground trees and all branches, the foreground lattice brick wall and long path, all side halls, lanterns and signs. Continue only the simple roof and veranda outlines hidden by tree trunks, following their visible symmetric counterpart; do not invent ornament. All roof tiles and masonry should be implied with widely spaced single fine lines only, no closely packed brick joints or shadow. Pure white walls and openings. site_recommendation.name: 新绛福胜寺
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1300仅作元代遗构约略排序，不声称该年建成。
site_recommendation.place: 山西新绛 · 泽掌镇光村
site_recommendation.lede: 光村福胜寺依地势层层展开，弥陀殿以重檐和围廊安顿内外空间。元代木构与殿内彩塑相互依存，北立面更能看清屋檐、后墙与廊柱的层次。

facts.label: 元代殿宇
facts.text: 弥陀殿保存元代木构，明弘治年间重修；寺院创建沿革不能直接替代现存殿宇年代。

facts.label: 重檐围廊
facts.text: 弥陀殿五间见方，重檐歇山顶，四周围廊；南面高台与北面后院高差各异。

facts.label: 彩塑遗存
facts.text: 殿内保存弥陀佛、胁侍菩萨与渡海观音等彩塑，不同塑像经历后世修补；本图绘殿宇北面。
